invariants.rationale: The method directly accesses layer fields and calls methods (e.g., getWidth, getHeight), so layer must be non-null.
Layer width is used as a bound in Math.max/Math.min, and for tiling dimensions, so it should not be negative.
Layer height is an array/grid bound and is assumed non-negative when iterating cells.
Tile width is multiplied and used as a divisor, so it must be positive to avoid division by zero.
Tile height is used as a dimension and divisor, so it must be positive.
